blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon, Philippines — Police arrested 11 Chinese nationals and a Filipino driver in Nasugbu, Batangas, early Thursday morning, Nov. 19, for allegedly operating a business without the required government permits. The Batangas Police Provincial Office (BPPO) said in a report that the suspects, aged 23 to 36, and the 53-year-old Filipino driver were arrested in Sitio Batulao, Barangay Kaylaway. The operation followed reports of a business establishment allegedly operating without the necessary permits, in violation of Republic Act No. 7160, or the Local Government Code of 1991, and Republic Act No. 11917, also known as the Private Security Services […]...
